# Historical provenance fixture

The manifests, lockfile and SDK metadata preserve the original bytes from
[CLI `bb5d6bc`](https://github.com/AllowIt-hq/allowit-cli/tree/bb5d6bc613439c08ee4b2a330c40360741f0d133).
The provenance tests use this schema 1 input independently of the SDK client facade.
The fixture helper clones the recorded SDK revision from the initialized local submodule.
